Meta Richland Parish / Hyperion AI campus
status_as_of_cutoff: Under construction with a major announced expansion. LPSC approved generation/transmission resources for service to the North Louisiana customer project, but that utility order is not a local land-use or building approval and does not establish full-campus completion or energized IT load.

actions.result_status: LED announced Meta’s planned $10 billion-plus AI-optimized data center in northeast Louisiana/Richland Parish; the announcement did not publish a parish building permit or vote tally.
actions.access_caveat: State announcement is not parish zoning, building, or occupancy approval.
actions.evidence_note: The announcement is retained as state/company evidence, separate from later LPSC utility action.

actions.government_body: Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development
actions.result_status: DOTD announced conversion of three US 80 intersections near the Meta development site to all-way stop control following a traffic-engineering study; this is roadway context, not site-plan or building approval.
actions.access_caveat: DOTD announcement does not disclose the private site permit register or construction/occupancy status.
actions.evidence_note: Traffic action confirms project-related public infrastructure context, not a vote on the data center.

actions.result_status: LPSC Order U-37425 accepted a settlement and approved the generation and transmission resources proposed in connection with service to a single customer project in North Louisiana, subject to conditions; LPSC docket materials identify the customer project as Meta/Laidley in Richland Parish.
actions.vote_tally: not published in the accessible order synopsis
actions.access_caveat: Utility commission approval is not parish zoning, a building permit, a CO, or proof that IT load is energized.
actions.evidence_note: This is the strongest government action located, but it is expressly limited to utility generation/transmission resources.

actions.government_body: Louisiana Economic Development / Louisiana Public Service Commission docket
actions.result_status: LED’s docket letter states Evest LLC, a Meta subsidiary, expressed interest in a significant Richland Parish investment conditional on power availability, including initial utility contract power by 2028; this is not a new parish approval.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: LPSC docket exhibit; docket number not assigned in the letter
actions.access_caveat: The filing is an economic-development confirmation in a utility docket and uses conditional language; it does not establish a building permit or live service.
actions.evidence_note: Conditional power language is preserved because it conflicts with any assumption of completed energization.
